notes: Tetum takes its month names from Portuguese and respells them by its own rules — Marsu for março, Abríl for abril with the acute that marks the stressed final syllable, Juñu and Jullu for junho and julho where nh becomes ñ and lh becomes ll. The weekdays are the Portuguese counting series, segunda-feira through sesta-feira, with Domingu and Sábadu at the ends; Timor-Leste writes dates day-first as Portugal does.
